treks.name: Harishchandragad Fort Trek
treks.meetingPoint: Kalyan Railway Station, Mumbai or Shivajinagar, Pune
treks.description: Harishchandragad is one of the most historic and scenic hill forts in the Western Ghats. Known for its massive semi-circular cliff - the Kokankada (Cobra's Hood), which offers a breathtaking vertical drop of 2,000 feet, and the beautiful Kedareshwar Cave where a huge Shiva Linga stands surrounded by water. This adventure includes trekking, exploration of caves, historical fort ruins, sunset from Kokankada, and overnight camping under a million stars.

itinerary.title: Departure & Base Village Ascent
items: Meeting at Kalyan Station (10:00 PM) / Pune Shivajinagar (9:30 PM)
Private vehicle transfer to Pachnai (Base Village)
Midnight journey through the scenic Malshej Ghat
Reach base village Pachnai by 4:00 AM; rest for a while

itinerary.title: Trek, Kokankada Sunset & Camping
items: Wake up call at 6:00 AM, freshen up and have a hot local breakfast
Trek begins from Pachnai through lush forest trails (approx. 2.5 - 3 hours)
Reach the fort plateau, visit Kedareshwar Cave and Harishchandreshwar Temple
Check-in at camping site, enjoy a freshly prepared hot Maharashtrian lunch
Evening walk to the legendary Kokankada for a majestic sunset experience
Campfire, fun activities, dinner, and overnight stay in tents

itinerary.title: Taramati Sunrise & Descent
items: Early morning hike to Taramati Peak (highest point of the fort) for sunrise
Return to tents, have breakfast and tea
Pack bags and begin descent back to Pachnai village
Lunch at base village and start return journey in private vehicle
Reach Kalyan / Pune by 8:00 PM with unforgettable memories

included: Private transport (Non-AC) from Mumbai/Pune to base village and back
Day 1: Evening Tea; Day 2: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner; Day 3: Breakfast, Lunch
Accommodation in sharing tents (Tents, sleeping mats, and blankets provided)
Experienced and certified Trek Leaders
Local guide and forest entry charges
First aid support and safety equipment
excluded: Personal expenses (mineral water, cold drinks, etc.)
Any meals during the travel on Day 1 night or Day 3 night
Emergency expenses caused by weather, landslides, or road blocks
Anything not specifically listed under inclusions
thingsToCarry: Double strap backpack (30-40 Litres) to carry your gear
Torch or headlamp with extra batteries
Warm clothes (jacket/sweater) as nights get cold on the fort
Change of clothes (2 sets) and extra socks
Energy snacks like biscuits, dry fruits, ORS, or Glucon-D
safetyRules: Littering is strictly prohibited. Keep mountains clean.
Consuming alcohol, smoking, or any toxic substance is strictly banned during the trek.
Trekkers must follow instructions of the Trek Leader at all times.
The organizer reserve the rights to change/modify the itinerary due to weather or safety conditions.
Average physical fitness is required. People with asthma or heart conditions should consult a doctor before registering.

treks.name: Kalsubai Peak Monsoon Trek
treks.description: Scale the highest peak of Maharashtra! Standing tall at 1,646 meters (5,400 feet), Kalsubai Peak offers an unmatched panoramic view of the Sahyadri ranges. The trekking route is well-defined with iron ladders installed in steep rock patches for safety. In monsoon and post-monsoon, the peak is wrapped in thick clouds, surrounded by blooming wild flowers and gushing waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Night Meet & Summit
items: Gather at Kasara Station by 1:30 AM and board local vehicles to Bari village
Reach Bari base village by 3:00 AM, brief introduction, and instructions
Begin the night trek by 3:30 AM under the guidance of our lead crew
Climb up steel ladders and rocky trails through cool breeze and mist
Reach the summit temple of Kalsubai by 6:30 AM for a glorious cloudy sunrise
Explore the summit, capture pictures, and begin the descent by 8:00 AM
Reach Bari village by 11:30 AM, freshen up and indulge in local village lunch
Depart in sharing vehicles to Kasara Station by 2:30 PM
Board train to Mumbai with the pride of scaling Maharashtra's highest peak!

included: Local transport from Kasara Station to Bari base village and back
Unlimited hot Maharashtrian breakfast & tea at Bari village
Traditional vegetarian home-cooked lunch at Bari village
Trek leaders, local guides, and safety crew fees
Bhandardara wildlife sanctuary entry charges
Basic first-aid support
excluded: Train tickets/travel up to Kasara Station
Personal expenses, bottled water, or extra snacks
Anything not mentioned in the inclusions
thingsToCarry: Good trekking shoes with rubber grip (no sandals/slippers)
Raincoat/Poncho and plastic bags to keep electronics dry
Torch or headlamp with extra batteries (essential for night walk)
A set of dry clothes to change after the trek
safetyRules: No littering. Bring back your own thrash.
Strictly no alcohol/smoking/narcotics on the trek.
Always walk in group and follow the trek leaders' trail.
Be extremely careful on the steel ladders, maintain distance.

treks.name: Rajmachi Fort & Camping
treks.description: Rajmachi is a historical fort located in the rugged Sahyadri mountains. It consists of two twin fortresses: Shrivardhan and Manaranjan. The trek is extremely popular for its scenic trails, historic structures, ancient water tanks, Buddhist caves, and during pre-monsoon, the magical fireflies show! This trek includes camping in the base village Udhewadi and exploring both forts at sunrise.

itinerary.title: Lonavala Rendezvous & Firefly Trail
items: Assemble at Lonavala Station (3:00 PM) and board 4x4 vehicles to Udhewadi
Scenic off-road drive (1.5 hours) through the dense forest
Reach base village Udhewadi, check-in, set up tents and enjoy evening tea
Post-sunset, go for a short forest trail to spot magical fireflies (seasonal)
Enjoy a piping hot local dinner followed by stargazing and stories

itinerary.title: Double Fort Ascent & Return
items: Wake up early by 5:30 AM, enjoy hot tea
Ascent Shrivardhan Fort (approx. 45 mins) to witness the sunrise and surrounding valleys
Explore historical bastions, water reservoirs, and structures on the fort
Brief trek to Manaranjan Fort if time permits, then descend to base village
Delicious Maharashtrian breakfast at Udhewadi, pack bags
Board 4x4 vehicles back to Lonavala Station
Reach Lonavala by 1:30 PM and head back to Mumbai/Pune

included: 4x4 transport from Lonavala Station to Udhewadi and back
Saturday: Evening Tea & Biscuits, Village Dinner (Veg/Non-Veg)
Sunday: Morning Tea, Local Breakfast
Tents stay with mats and clean bedding on sharing basis
First-aid support, expert leaders & guides
Rajmachi forest entry fees
excluded: Sunday lunch (you can have it in Lonavala city)
Any additional transport or medical emergency expenses
thingsToCarry: Torch or headlamp (must-have for night/firefly walk)
Light warm clothing (nights can be breezy)
safetyRules: Respect the forest and wildlife. Do not shout or play loud music.
Smoking and drinking alcohol are strictly banned.
Keep the tents zipped up to avoid bugs/insects entering.
Trek leaders' instructions are final.

treks.name: Devkund Waterfall Trek
treks.description: Devkund Waterfall is a hidden gem located in the dense forests near Bhira Dam. It is the confluence of three rivers and is believed to be the origin of the Kundalika River. The trek passes through lush forests, river streams, and wooden bridges, culminating at the spectacular Devkund pool where water plunges from a height of over 150 feet. It is a perfect beginner-friendly adventure trail.

itinerary.title: Forest Trail & Devkund Pool
items: Pick up from Dadar (5:00 AM) / Swargate (5:30 AM) in private bus
Enjoy breakfast on the way to Bhira village
Reach Bhira base by 9:00 AM, brief check, register, and start the trek
Trek through a dense forest canopy, crossing small streams (approx. 2 hours)
Reach the breathtaking Devkund Waterfall; marvel at the plunge pool
Relax, capture memories (swimming is prohibited in deep zone for safety)
Trek back to Bhira base village by 2:30 PM
Freshen up and enjoy a hearty hot local lunch
Board the private bus and start return journey by 4:30 PM
Arrive in Mumbai / Pune by 9:00 PM

included: Bus transport from Dadar/Swargate to Bhira and back
Breakfast & Tea on the way, Buffet Lunch (Veg) at base village
Forest entry fees, local guide charges, and expert crew guidance
First-aid support and life jackets on standby (if needed)
thingsToCarry: Extra pair of dry clothes & towel (you will get wet)
Dry bags/plastic wraps for phones and cameras
safetyRules: Entering the deep danger zone of Devkund pool is strictly banned. Follow safety ropes.
No littering in the reserve forest area.
Alcohol and smoking are strictly forbidden.
Walk on the marked trail, do not wander off alone in the forest.

treks.name: Sandhan Valley Canyon Trek
treks.description: Sandhan Valley is known as the 'Valley of Shadow' or the 'Grand Canyon of Maharashtra'. It is a unique water-carved valley about 200 feet deep and 1.5 miles long. The trek involves walking through narrow ravines where sunlight rarely reaches, wading through cold pools of chest-deep water, and rappelling down steep rock faces using ropes. This is a thrilling adventure that ends with camping near the blue waters of Bhandardara lake.

itinerary.title: Night Travel & Base Village Arrival
items: Assemble at Kasara Station (10:30 PM Friday) and travel to Samrad in local jeeps
Reach Samrad by 2:00 AM, rest in a local homestay

itinerary.title: Canyon Descent & Rappelling
items: Wake up at 5:30 AM, have hot breakfast and tea
Start the trek into the narrow canyon by 6:30 AM
Wade through cold pools of water, navigate massive boulders
Experience thrill at 3 technical rappelling patches (up to 45 ft drop)
Reach base camping site by 4:30 PM, pitch tents, and relax
Enjoy bonfire, delicious dinner, and sleep in the wilderness

itinerary.title: 湖畔 Sunrise & Return Journey
items: Wake up to a crisp morning, enjoy hot breakfast near the stream
Short trek to Dehne village (approx. 2.5 hours)
Have lunch at Dehne homestay, pack up
Travel from Dehne to Asangaon Station in local transport
Board local train to Mumbai, reach by 7:00 PM Sunday

included: Transport Kasara to Samrad, and Dehne to Asangaon
Saturday: Homestay rest, Breakfast, Lunch (Packed), Dinner at campsite
Sunday: Breakfast, Lunch at Dehne village
Adventure gear (harness, helmets, ropes, carabiners)
Certified technical team and safety coordinators
Tents with mats & sheets on sharing basis
excluded: Train travel up to Kasara/from Asangaon
Expenses due to early exit from trek or medical evacuations
thingsToCarry: Trekking shoes with rubber soles (compulsory, shoes might get wet/soiled)
Backpack (wrap clothes in plastic inside to keep them dry)
Torch or headlamp with extra batteries (compulsory)
Full length track pants and full sleeve shirts (avoid shorts due to thorns/boulders)
Warm jacket (canyon nights are very cold)
safetyRules: This is an extreme trek. Average physical fitness and mental grit are required.
Strictly obey the instructions of the technical rappelling leaders.
Consuming alcohol/smoking is completely prohibited.
Keep hands free; do not carry cameras or phones loose during rock crawls.

treks.name: Prabalgad Fort Trek
treks.meetingPoint: Panvel Railway Station, near ticket counter
treks.description: Prabalgad Fort is situated adjacent to Kalavantin Durg. It is covered with dense forests and features a flat plateau summit. Prabalmachi, the base village, offers a stunning view of both the Kalavantin Durg pinnacle and Prabalgad cliff. This trek involves crossing beautiful streams and hiking through lush green tree canopies.

timeSlots.description: Assemble at Panvel station, proceed to Thakurwadi village by shared vehicles.
Reach Thakurwadi base, begin trekking towards Prabalmachi.
Breakfast at Prabalmachi, proceed with the climb to Prabalgad plateau.
Reach Prabalgad summit, explore ruins, watch towers, and the stone pond.
Descend to Prabalmachi village and have hot local Maharashtrian lunch.
Begin final descent to Thakurwadi village.
Shared vehicles back to Panvel station, bid goodbye!

included: Transport from Panvel to base village & return
Local veg breakfast & hot lunch at Prabalmachi
TAF certified trek leaders & guides fees
First-Aid & emergency assistance
thingsToCarry: Double strap backpack to keep hands free
safetyRules: Strictly obey the instructions of the trek captains.
Refrain from taking selfies near high cliffs.
Alcohol and smoking are completely banned.

treks.name: Harihar Fort Peak
treks.meetingPoint: Dadar East Railway Station, near Swaminarayan Temple
treks.description: Famous for its iconic 80-degree vertical rock-cut stairs. This trek is a thrilling climb carved out on a triangular prism-shaped hill. It offers panoramic views of Vaitarna lake, Bhaskargad, and the surrounding Trimbak range.

timeSlots.description: Depart from Mumbai (Dadar) in a private bus towards Nirgudpada village.
Reach Nirgudpada, freshen up and have hot Maharashtrian breakfast.
Briefing session and start the hike towards Harihar Fort plateau.
Reach the base of the iconic rock-cut vertical stairs and begin climbing with safety ropes.
Explore the summit, temples, water ponds, and catch views of the Trimbak range.
Carefully start descending the steep rock steps.
Reach Nirgudpada base, feast on a traditional Maharashtrian lunch.
Depart for Mumbai in our private bus.
Back in Dadar, Mumbai, carrying thrilling memories.

included: Private bus transport from Dadar/Thane to Nashik & return
Traditional local breakfast & hot veg lunch at base village
Technical safety climbing ropes and harnesses setup
Certified TAF mountaineering captains fees
thingsToCarry: Quality trekking shoes with rubber grip (no sandals)
Full length track pants and full sleeve shirts
safetyRules: Obey technical climb marshals at the steep steps patch.
Do not rush or crowd the rock stairs; maintain distance.
Consuming liquor or smoking during the trek will result in immediate disqualification.

treks.name: Pratapgad Heritage Trek
treks.description: Pratapgad Fort is a major historical fort built by Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Site of the historic battle of Pratapgad between Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Afzal Khan. Features double-walled fortifications, temples, and a massive bronze statue of Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

timeSlots.description: Depart from Dadar/Thane via private AC bus towards Mahabaleshwar.
Reach the base valley of Pratapgad, have breakfast.
Begin the easy guided walk to the fort gates (Maha Darwaza).
Explore Afzal tower, Bhavani Temple, and catch spectacular views of Jawali valley.
Enjoy fresh local Mahabaleshwar strawberries and hot lunch.
Depart for Mumbai in our private bus.
Reach Dadar, Mumbai, concluding our historic journey.

included: AC private bus travel from Mumbai & return
Guided heritage historical tour fees
Tasty local breakfast and full lunch
TAF certified trek coordinators
safetyRules: Maintain decorum as this is a heritage historical monument.
Refrain from climbing on high historical fort walls.
No smoking or drinking allowed.

treks.name: Sindhudurg Fort Sea Expedition
treks.description: A spectacular sea fort built by Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj on Kurte Island off the Malvan coast. It features massive stone walls designed to withstand ocean currents, historical temples, and three sweet water wells. Includes beach camping and local Konkani seafood.

itinerary.title: Boat ride to Sea Fort & Beach Camping

timeSlots.description: Depart from Mumbai on Friday night in an overnight AC sleeper bus.
Reach Malvan on Saturday morning, check into beachside camp, have breakfast.
Boat ride to Sindhudurg Fort, guided historical exploration.
Return to shore, enjoy traditional Malvani lunch (Seafood / Veg).
Water sports at the beach, sunset view, campfire and music at night.
Breakfast, gear up for scuba diving session at the coral reef patch.
Lunch at Malvan town, buy local mango products.
Board the return AC sleeper bus to Mumbai.
Reach Dadar, Mumbai, on Monday morning.

included: Sleeper AC bus ticket from Mumbai to Malvan & return
Beachside camping tents twin sharing with clean washrooms
Sindhudurg Fort entry tickets and ferry rides
All meals (Saturday Breakfast to Sunday Lunch) with traditional Malvani flavor
Trained scuba instructor and basic water sports package
thingsToCarry: Extra pair of clothes for beach activities
safetyRules: Follow the instructions of the water sport crew during scuba sessions.
Do not venture deep into the sea without safety life jackets.
Refrain from consuming alcohol during beach activities.
